description: SPIKE 005 bundled-PDF router (GA): splits a file into cover letter / invoice / other segments and routes invoice segments to sprk_invoice_v1.

invoice.description: A law-firm invoice or statement for legal services: invoice number, fee time entries, expenses and totals due.

cover_letter.description: A cover or transmittal letter, remittance advice or email that accompanies an invoice but is not itself the invoice.

other.description: Any other page that is neither an invoice nor its cover letter.
